terms.definition: Atoms add across the C=C double bond, so it becomes a single bond; alkenes react with hydrogen, water and halogens.
Alkene + steam → alcohol, with a catalyst.
Contains the –OH functional group; methanol, ethanol, propanol, butanol.
terms.examiner: Separate Chemistry. Ethanol is used as a fuel and solvent.

terms.definition: Sugar solutions are converted to ethanol by yeast at 30 °C in anaerobic conditions.
Contains the –COOH functional group; methanoic, ethanoic, propanoic, butanoic acid.
terms.examiner: Separate Chemistry. They are weak acids.

terms.definition: Made when a carboxylic acid reacts with an alcohol, using an acid catalyst; ethyl ethanoate is the example.
